name: Xenophanes
biography: Briefly discussed as a minor, transitional figure between Pythagoras and Heraclitus: an Ionian-born freethinker who mocked anthropomorphic religion (arguing that if oxen could paint gods, they would paint them as oxen) and the Pythagorean doctrine of transmigration, and who held that certain truth about the gods is unattainable by any man.
